title: Giving reasons and purposes: as, because, in order to, so that
summary: Как выражать причину (because, as, since, for, because of, due to) и цель (to, in order to, so as to, so that, in case) и чем они различаются по стилю и конструкции.
ru:
## Причина: because, as, since, for
Все четыре слова вводят причину, но различаются по стилю и по тому, насколько причина «новая» для слушателя.
- **because** — самый нейтральный; причина — главная информация, ответ на вопрос why.
> I stayed at home **because** I had a fever. — Я остался дома, потому что у меня была температура.
- **as** и **since** — причина уже известна или не так важна; обычно в начале предложения, звучат формальнее.
> **As** nobody objected, the proposal was accepted. — Поскольку никто не возражал, предложение приняли.
> **Since** you're here, you may as well help. — Раз уж ты здесь, можешь помочь.
- **for** — книжное, «ибо»; никогда не стоит в начале и обычно отделяется запятой: *He must be ill, for he hasn't been to work all week.*
Также полезны **now that** (раз уж теперь), **seeing that** и **given that**: *Now that the exams are over, we can relax.*

## Причина + существительное: because of, due to, owing to
После **because** — придаточное предложение (подлежащее + глагол), после **because of** — существительное или герундий.
> The match was cancelled **because of** the snow. — Матч отменили из-за снега.
- **due to** — чаще после глагола be: *The delay was **due to** a technical fault.* Многие носители используют и в начале предложения: *Due to the strike, ...*
- **owing to**, **on account of** — формальные, обычно в начале или после основной части.
- **thanks to** — причина с положительным (или иронично-положительным) оттенком: *Thanks to your help, we finished early.*
- ~~because the snow~~ → because **of** the snow; ~~due of~~ → due **to**.

## Цель: to, in order to, so as to
Если подлежащее одно и то же, используем инфинитив:
> She took a taxi **to** avoid being late. — Она взяла такси, чтобы не опоздать.
> **In order to** qualify, applicants must pass a test. — Чтобы пройти отбор, нужно сдать тест.
**In order to / so as to** звучат формальнее и подчёркивают намерение. В отрицательной форме нужны именно они: ~~to not wake~~ → **so as not to** wake / **in order not to** wake the baby.

## Цель: so that, in order that
Если подлежащие разные или в придаточном есть модальный глагол, нужен **so that** (формально **in order that**). В разговорной речи **that** часто опускают.
> I'm sending the files now **so that** you **can** read them tonight. — Отправляю сейчас, чтобы вы могли прочитать вечером.
> She whispered **so (that)** the children **wouldn't** hear. — Она говорила шёпотом, чтобы дети не услышали.
Общее правило: настоящее / будущее в главной части → **can, will, won't**; прошлое → **could, would, wouldn't**.

## in case: на случай, если
**In case** — это не **if**: действие в главной части делаем **заранее**, а не при условии. После in case — present simple (или should), в прошлом — past simple.
> Take a sweater **in case** it gets cold. — Возьми свитер на случай, если похолодает.
> I bought two copies **in case** one **got** damaged.
Перед существительным: **in case of** (в случае): *In case of fire, use the stairs.* — это уже ближе к if.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~She left early for avoid the traffic.~~ → She left early **to** avoid the traffic.
- ~~I'll take a map in case I will get lost.~~ → in case I **get** lost.
- ~~He did it because of he was afraid.~~ → because **he was** afraid / because **of his fear**.
- ~~It was so a good film.~~ → It was **such a** good film / **so** good.
en:
## Reasons: because, as, since, for
These words all introduce a reason, but they differ in style and in how new the reason is.
- **because** is the neutral choice; the reason is the key information.
> I stayed at home **because** I had a fever.
- **as** and **since** suggest the reason is already known or less important; usually at the start and more formal.
> **As** nobody objected, the proposal was accepted.
> **Since** you're here, you may as well help.
- **for** is literary; it never starts a sentence and is normally preceded by a comma: *He must be ill, for he hasn't been in all week.*
Also useful: **now that**, **seeing that**, **given that**.

## Reasons with nouns: because of, due to, owing to
**because** is followed by a clause; **because of** by a noun or an -ing form.
> The match was cancelled **because of** the snow.
- **due to** usually follows be: *The delay was **due to** a technical fault.* It is also common at the start of a sentence.
- **owing to** and **on account of** are formal.
- **thanks to** gives a positive (or ironic) reason: *Thanks to your help, we finished early.*
- ~~because the snow~~ → because **of** the snow; ~~due of~~ → due **to**.

## Purpose: to, in order to, so as to
When the subject is the same, use an infinitive:
> She took a taxi **to** avoid being late.
> **In order to** qualify, applicants must pass a test.
**In order to / so as to** are more formal and stress intention. For negatives we need them: ~~to not wake~~ → **so as not to** wake / **in order not to** wake the baby.

## Purpose: so that, in order that
Use **so that** (formally **in order that**) when the subjects differ or when there is a modal verb. **That** is often dropped in speech.
> I'm sending the files now **so that** you **can** read them tonight.
> She whispered **so (that)** the children **wouldn't** hear.
Present / future main clause → **can, will, won't**; past → **could, would, wouldn't**.

## in case
**In case** is not **if**: you act **in advance**. It takes the present simple (or should); in the past, the past simple.
> Take a sweater **in case** it gets cold.
> I bought two copies **in case** one **got** damaged.
Before a noun: **in case of** (= if there is): *In case of fire, use the stairs.*

## Common mistakes
- ~~for avoid~~ → **to** avoid
- ~~in case I will get lost~~ → in case I **get** lost
- ~~because of he was afraid~~ → because **he was** afraid
- ~~so a good film~~ → **such a** good film / **so** good
structure:
## Причина
| Форма | После неё | Стиль | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|
| because | clause | нейтральный | I left because I was tired. |
| as / since | clause | формальнее, начало фразы | As it was late, we left. |
| for | clause | книжный, после запятой | He left, for he was tired. |
| because of | noun / -ing | нейтральный | because of the rain |
| due to / owing to | noun / -ing | формальный | due to the delay |
| thanks to | noun | положительная причина | thanks to your help |

## Цель
| Ситуация | Конструкция | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| одно подлежащее | to / in order to / so as to + V | I called to ask about the fee. |
| одно подлежащее, отрицание | in order not to / so as not to + V | so as not to be late |
| разные подлежащие | so (that) + can / will | so that you can read it |
| прошедшее | so (that) + could / would | so that we could leave |
| на случай | in case + present / past simple | in case it rains |

## Формулы
> главная часть + **so that** + подлежащее + can / could / will / would / won't
> **In case of** + noun, ... = If there is + noun, ...
> **such a** + adj + noun + that ...  ·  **so** + adj + that ...

exercises.title: Причина и цель: вставьте слово
exercises.instruction: Вставьте подходящее слово или словосочетание (если возможны варианты, достаточно одного).
exercises.example: Take an umbrella ___ it rains. → **in case**

items.text: The match was postponed {{because of|due to|owing to|on account of}} the heavy snow.
{{As|Since|Because}} nobody objected, the proposal was accepted.
Take an umbrella {{in case}} it rains.
She spoke slowly {{so that|in order that|so}} everyone could follow.
He left early {{so as not to|in order not to}} miss the flight.
items.hint: not to / so as not to

items.text: {{Now that|Since|As}} the exams are over, we can relax.
I'm saving money {{to|in order to|so as to}} buy a flat.
The delay was due {{to}} a technical fault.

exercises.title: Формы после so that, in case, such/so
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужные слова или форму глагола.

items.text: Write it down so that you {{won't|will not}} forget the password.
She whispered so that the children {{wouldn't|would not}} hear.
I'll leave a key with my neighbour in case you {{arrive|should arrive|get here}} early.
He took a taxi {{in order|so as}} to avoid the rush hour.
I bought two copies in case one {{got|gets|should get}} damaged.
{{Due to|Owing to|Because of|On account of}} the strike, all trains were suspended.
It was so cold {{that}} the lake froze overnight.
She is such a talented pianist {{that}} critics compare her to the greats.

exercises.title: Выберите правильный вариант
exercises.instruction: Выберите вариант, подходящий по грамматике и смыслу.

items.q: She apologised ___ she had been rude.
items.why: Дальше идёт целое предложение (she had been rude), значит нужен союз **because**; because of / due to — только с существительным.

items.q: ___ it was raining, we cancelled the picnic.
items.why: **As** в начале предложения — причина известна; **for** в начало не ставят, in case даёт другой смысл («на случай»).

items.q: Take a sweater ___ it gets cold in the evening.
items.why: Действие делаем заранее, **на случай** похолодания; in case of требует существительного.

items.q: We use encryption ___ unauthorised people can't read the data.
items.why: Подлежащие разные (we / people) и есть can — нужен **so that**.

items.q: He closed the door quietly ___ wake the baby.
items.why: Отрицательная цель при одном подлежащем: **so as not to** / in order not to.

items.q: In ___ of fire, leave the building by the stairs.
The hotel was fully booked ___ the festival.
items.why: После слова идёт существительное (the festival) — **because of**.

items.q: I'm learning Italian ___ I can talk to my in-laws.
items.why: В придаточном есть своё подлежащее и can — только **so that** (in order to требует инфинитива).

options: I took a map in case I will get lost.
I took a map in case I got lost.
I took a map in case of I got lost.
items.why: После in case — past simple / present simple, без will; in case of — только с существительным.

options: The delay was due to the fog.
The delay was due of the fog.
The delay was because the fog.
items.why: **due to** + существительное; ~~due of~~ и ~~because the fog~~ — ошибки.

options: She left early for avoid the traffic.
She left early to avoid the traffic.
She left early for to avoid the traffic.
items.why: Цель при одном подлежащем — инфинитив **to avoid**, не for.

options: He wore glasses in order to not be recognised.
He wore glasses in order not to be recognised.
He wore glasses in order that not be recognised.
items.why: Отрицание ставится перед to: **in order not to**.

options: I'll write it down so that I'll not forget.
I'll write it down so that I won't forget.
I'll write it down so that I wouldn't forget.
items.why: Главная часть в будущем — в придаточном цели **won't**; wouldn't — для прошлого.

options: Since you're already here, you can help me.
For you're already here, you can help me.
Because of you're already here, you can help me.
items.why: **Since** в начале — известная причина; for в начало не ставят, because of требует существительного.

options: It was such a good film that we saw it twice.
It was so good film that we saw it twice.
It was so a good film that we saw it twice.

exercises.title: Соедините предложения
exercises.instruction: Соедините предложения, используя слова в скобках. Порядок частей может быть любым.

items.prompt: She took a taxi. She wanted to avoid being late. (in order to)
answers: She took a taxi in order to avoid being late.
In order to avoid being late, she took a taxi.
In order to avoid being late she took a taxi.

items.prompt: He closed the door quietly. He didn't want to wake the baby. (so as not to)
answers: He closed the door quietly so as not to wake the baby.
So as not to wake the baby, he closed the door quietly.
So as not to wake the baby he closed the door quietly.

items.prompt: I'm sending the files now. You can review them tonight. (so that)
answers: I'm sending the files now so that you can review them tonight.
I am sending the files now so that you can review them tonight.

items.prompt: The match was cancelled. There was heavy rain. (because of)
answers: The match was cancelled because of the heavy rain.
Because of the heavy rain, the match was cancelled.
The match was cancelled because of heavy rain.
Because of heavy rain, the match was cancelled.
Because of the heavy rain the match was cancelled.
Because of heavy rain the match was cancelled.

items.prompt: Take your passport. They may ask for ID. (in case)
answers: Take your passport in case they ask for ID.
Take your passport in case they should ask for ID.
Take your passport in case they may ask for ID.
Take your passport in case they might ask for ID.

items.prompt: Because the roads were icy, the bus was late. (As)
answers: As the roads were icy, the bus was late.
The bus was late as the roads were icy.
As the roads were icy the bus was late.

items.prompt: He went to the pharmacy for buy some aspirin.
answers: He went to the pharmacy to buy some aspirin.
He went to the pharmacy in order to buy some aspirin.
He went to the pharmacy so as to buy some aspirin.

items.prompt: I'll take a coat in case it will rain.
answers: I'll take a coat in case it rains.
I will take a coat in case it rains.
I'll take a coat in case it should rain.
I will take a coat in case it should rain.

items.prompt: She did it because of she was afraid.
answers: She did it because she was afraid.
She did it because of her fear.

items.prompt: To not miss the train, we ran.
answers: In order not to miss the train, we ran.
So as not to miss the train, we ran.
Not to miss the train, we ran.
In order not to miss the train we ran.
So as not to miss the train we ran.
Not to miss the train we ran.

items.prompt: The film was such boring that I left.
answers: The film was so boring that I left.
It was such a boring film that I left.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя изученные конструкции.

items.prompt: Why are you learning English? Use to / in order to.
items.sample: I'm learning English in order to read scientific articles in the original.

items.prompt: What do you always take with you in case something happens? Use in case.
items.sample: I always carry a power bank in case my phone dies.

items.prompt: Describe a recent delay or cancellation. Use because of or due to.
items.sample: My flight was delayed because of a storm over the mountains.

items.prompt: Name something you do so that your day goes more smoothly. Use so that.
items.sample: I prepare my bag the night before so that I don't rush in the morning.
